Title: sign (
Description:
sign returns either -1, 0 or 1 depending whether its numeric argument is negative, zero or positive.
sign(-12)			-> -1
sign(0)				-> 0
sign(910)			-> 1
sign(atof('-1.23456789'))	-> -1
sign(0.0)			-> 0
